pages.text: One you've got your $(bold)mud bricks$(), you're ready to craft a $(bold)mud furnace$() and smelt some $(bold)raw minerals$().
The mud furnace is the first iteration of a furnace you will get. It works to cook basic materials, like food, copper and to make charcoal.
Before you can craft the mud furnace, you will need cobblestone. Cobblestone is made combining 4 cobble pieces.
Combining mud bricks with cobblestone, you will get your first mud furnace.
